items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: It's like a lot of people say. Well, take a football team. Knute Rockne, Rockne and Notre Dame.

ctx.x: happening out West, but we were the first because the man that could have been first, he wasn't. That was because he sacrificed for sensation, he sacrificed teamwork. That was Fletcher Henderson. And, but you can't do that. That's the reason as a good football player, having been the coach of a football team, Notre Dame. Reason they were the greatest. It was because of the teamwork. And when the leader of an organization forgets that teamwork, the individuals don't matter. It's the teamwork. And that's why we…
Uh hunh. Well, let's get back to 1926 now. Did you go to England during '26? When did you go to England?
